name: NZ Steel and Timber
source: Section data from the Revit steel families (UB axes corrected; HST properties left out). Bolt clearances from the Revit reference schedules. Timber from the supplier literature: Prolam Product List 2025, Futurebuild LVL design guides (2019, 2022) and SG8 stock sizes; Timber gauged is from the Revit type names (rows marked check).

categories.name: Timber gauged
categories.note: Sawn and gauged framing, depth x breadth in mm, from the Revit types Timber Framing and TIMBER GAUGED. Sizes are as named; grade and treatment are only filled in where the type name gives them. Check against NZS 3604 / the supplier before use. 2/ = two pieces side by side.

categories.name: Truss hangers (MiTek SA)
categories.note: MiTek South Africa eCo truss hangers (38, 50 and 76 wide; 1.0, 1.2 and 1.6 mm; 90 and 45 degrees) and strap hangers (1.0 mm). Widths and thicknesses from SA retailer listings; MiTek SA publishes no dimension table, so the height d, side plate L and face flange F are estimated (a 45 degree hanger is drawn square). The codes other than ETH38X1M are descriptive, not MiTek part numbers. Replace with the MiTek SA truss hanger brochure when available.

categories.name: Bolts
categories.note: minEdge and minPitch: enter from your NZS 3404 source; 0 = not set (no check). The same metric bolts are used in South Africa (grades 4.8 and 8.8).

categories.name: UB
categories.note: Universal beams, serial size h x b x mass (BS 4-1 / BS EN 10365). British Steel UK sections datasheets (CUBD:ENG:072026).

categories.name: UC
categories.note: Universal columns, serial size h x b x mass (BS 4-1 / BS EN 10365). British Steel UK sections datasheets (CUBD:ENG:072026).

categories.name: PFC
categories.note: Parallel flange channels, serial size h x b x mass (BS 4-1 / BS EN 10365). British Steel UK sections datasheets (CUBD:ENG:072026). 100, 125, 380 and 430 deep from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C.

categories.name: Equal angles
categories.note: Equal angles, h x b x t (BS EN 10056-1). Large sizes and J from British Steel UK sections datasheets (CUBD:ENG:072026). Smaller sizes from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C.

categories.name: Unequal angles
categories.note: Unequal angles, h x b x t (BS EN 10056-1). Large sizes and J from British Steel UK sections datasheets (CUBD:ENG:072026). Smaller sizes from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C.

categories.name: SHS
categories.note: Square hollow sections, hot finished, h x b x t (BS EN 10210-2). Mass, A, I and elastic modulus from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C. Plastic modulus S and torsion constant J calculated from the nominal dimensions (corner radii 1.5 t outside, 1.0 t inside). Cold-formed (EN 10219) sections differ.

categories.name: RHS
categories.note: Rectangular hollow sections, hot finished, h x b x t (BS EN 10210-2). Mass, A, I and elastic modulus from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C. Plastic modulus S and torsion constant J calculated from the nominal dimensions (corner radii 1.5 t outside, 1.0 t inside). Cold-formed (EN 10219) sections differ.

categories.name: CHS
categories.note: Circular hollow sections, hot finished, D x t (BS EN 10210-2). Mass, A, I and elastic modulus from Koyda Steel Section Tables KOY-STT-001 Rev C. Plastic modulus S and J calculated from the nominal dimensions.

categories.name: C16 sawn
